answer.reason: HOS 1:2-3 state a deed of Hosea: at the LORD's command he took Gomer as his wife.

clauses.english: took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim as his wife at the LORD's command
clauses.quote: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim

doubts: ROM 9:25 names Osee (Hosea) only as a quoted saying, not as an event, so it was left out.
